result_text:
Template literals are now masked the same way as `"..."` and `'...'` literals when units are compared for duplication. I haven't run a duplication test for the JavaScript case, and I didn't add one.

The change is one line in `extraCleanContent` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/units/CStyleHeuristicUnitsExtractor.java`. It replaces `` `...` `` with ` `` `, so `` `Hello alpha ${name}` `` and `` `Hello beta ${name}` `` become identical. It runs before the quote replacements. It also matches template literals that span several lines. Differences in the code outside the literals still keep units apart.

The existing `*Unit*` tests in the `codeanalyzer` module pass. A stray, unbalanced backtick would mask everything up to the next backtick in the file.
